title: Amazing Grace
author: John Newton
firstSlide:
Amazing grace! How sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!

title: Holy, Holy, Holy
author: Reginald Heber
firstSlide:
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee;

title: It Is Well with My Soul
author: Horatio Spafford
firstSlide:
When peace like a river attendeth my way,
When sorrows like sea billows roll;

title: Abide with Me
firstSlide:
Abide with me; fast falls the eventide;
The darkness deepens; Lord, with me abide;

title: Rock of Ages
author: Augustus Toplady
firstSlide:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;

title: Come, Thou Fount of Every Blessing
author: Robert Robinson
firstSlide:
Come, Thou Fount of every blessing,
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace;

title: A Mighty Fortress Is Our God
author: Martin Luther, Frederick H. Hedge
firstSlide:
A mighty fortress is our God,
A bulwark never failing;

title: Crown Him with Many Crowns
author: Matthew Bridges, Godfrey Thring
firstSlide:
Crown Him with many crowns,
The Lamb upon His throne;

title: Joyful, Joyful, We Adore Thee
author: Henry van Dyke
firstSlide:
Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee,
God of glory, Lord of love;

title: All Hail the Power of Jesus' Name
author: Edward Perronet
firstSlide:
All hail the power of Jesus' name!
Let angels prostrate fall;

title: Blessed Assurance
author: Fanny Crosby
firstSlide:
Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
O what a foretaste of glory divine!

title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus
author: Joseph M. Scriven
firstSlide:
What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!

title: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
author: Isaac Watts
firstSlide:
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,

title: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
author: Joachim Neander, Catherine Winkworth
firstSlide:
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him, for He is thy health and salvation!

title: Nearer, My God, to Thee
author: Sarah Flower Adams
firstSlide:
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!

title: Jesus Loves Me
author: Anna B. Warner
firstSlide:
Jesus loves me! This I know,
For the Bible tells me so;

title: Doxology
firstSlide:
Praise God, from whom all blessings flow;
Praise Him, all creatures here below;

title: Fairest Lord Jesus
author: Anonymous
firstSlide:
Fairest Lord Jesus,
Ruler of all nature,

title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross
author: Isaac Watts
firstSlide:
When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of glory died,

title: Be Still, My Soul
author: Katharina von Schlegel, tr. Jane Borthwick
firstSlide:
Be still, my soul: the Lord is on thy side;
Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain;
